title: Refuse a page-database write or a db-declaring publish for a waiting page
why: Owner ruling R28: page data has one store, git first, no copy step, no lag (step page-data-one-store).
source: coordinator 11:53 and 11:54 CST Nov 12, from lane page-data-one-store (decision waiting-page-one-store, route D: the page on claude.ai, no database, git through a connector)
note: Refuses an ArtifactData write naming a waiting-page URL and a waiting-page publish that declares db; a lint fails if page.html calls use("db"). Red first.
